attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Creates a ribbon, Copyright (C) 2018 Orkhan Ashrafov.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetParent: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- Mirror: True builds both L_ and R_ sides (auto-prefixes L_ if needed). Right_Only mirrors to the right side only. False builds as-is.
- Equal: evenly spaces controls and joints along the ribbon. When OFF, spacing follows the surface parameterization.
- Ctrls: number of IK controls along the ribbon (default 5).
- Joints: number of bind joints along the ribbon (default 5).
- Constraint: ON uses parentConstraint/scaleConstraint to link IK controls to their joints (supports offsets, more flexible). OFF uses direct attribute connections (lighter, no constraint overhead).
- AddFk: adds an FK control chain on top of the IK controls for layered animation.
- FkOnLast: when ON (and AddFk is ON), adds an FK control on the final IK control as well. Default is OFF, which skips the last control.
- Wire: uses a wire deformer instead of a skinCluster to drive the ribbon surface. Needs at least 2 controls.
- CtrlScales: when ON, unlocks scale attributes on the IK controls and connects them to the bind joints.
- JointOrient: when ON, bind joints orient to the nearest control joint instead of the follicle surface normal.
- MiddleCtrlPosition: where the main control is placed. Original uses the surface bounding box center. Start/End places it at the first/last bind joint.
- CtrlOrientation: SurfaceNormal keeps the default follicle orientation (Z follows surface normal). WorldForward orients controls and joints so Z faces world-forward and Y faces world-up.
- Gimbal: adds a nested gimbal control under the Ribbon Main Control for clean rotations.
- Template parent examples: Spine_End_Jnt, Head_Jnt, L_Wrist_Jnt.

Tips:
- if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly.
